incident-bot: ALERT → SEV2: KV cache tail-latency spike in eu-west-1 (alertgroup=cache-latency, impacted services: embeddings, chat-generation)

maya (oncall-primary): taking the handoff, summary below. I'm leaving in 10m; mike will be primary after that.

mike (oncall-secondary): ack. i'll be primary starting +10m. what is current customer impact? any pager storms?

maya (oncall-primary): short summary: 12:02 UTC we started seeing 95/99 p90->p99 jumps on KV GETs for shard eu-west-1a. Error rate low but tail latency affecting embeddings and chat routes for ~5% of requests. No full outages. Customers: two mid-size customers reported slower responses (ticket links: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-5271, https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-5272).

jess (platform-eng): mitigation in progress: increased replica count for affected cache pool from 4->6 via autoscaler override. Eviction pressure high; we're running prioritized eviction for large-key prefixes.

maya (oncall-primary): active alerts: 1) cache-tail-latency-eu-west (firing), 2) deployment-rolling-back-warning (flapping, but unrelated), 3) embeddings-queue-depth (transient spike).

maya (oncall-primary): mitigations attempted so far:
- manual scale override applied (cluster-controller): `kubectl patch hpa cache-eu-west -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`
- eviction policy switched to LRU-heavy, TTL enforcement tightened for ephemeral keys
- prefix-level prefetch disabled for embeddings clients to reduce read amplification

jess (platform-eng): logs snippet from the node with spikes:
```
2026-02-25T11:58:12.345Z cache-node-12 GET user_embeds:128ms 99th=1380ms evictions=120
2026-02-25T12:00:07.891Z cache-node-12 GET chat_ctx:45ms 99th=1120ms pending_io=42
```

mike (oncall-secondary): runbook reference? I want the exact playbook steps for fallback routing and customer notices.

maya (oncall-primary): runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-tail-latency. Key steps:
1) If >10% of requests >1s for 15m -> enable de-prioritized read routing (route to cold cache with quota)
2) If eviction rate >200/min -> enable aggressive TTL and force-evict large prefixes
3) Customer communications: coordinate with ops-liaison to send status updates to affected customers.

ops-liaison: I can draft a short status note after you confirm customer list. Suggest: "We are seeing intermittent latency increases for embeddings and chat in eu-west. Engineers have applied temporary scaling and eviction changes; we expect improvements within 15-30 minutes."

maya (oncall-primary): confirmed customers: cust-alpha, cust-bravo (see tickets). ops-liaison please send initial note and escalate to account reps for those two.

sre-bot: Metric update: cache GET p99 eu-west-1 = 1.2s (was 3.8s at peak), alert count down by 40% in last 8m.

jess (platform-eng): traffic routing change enacted: set `route.policy=prefer-warm` for embeddings in eu-west; this will send low-latency prefetched requests to warmer pools. Command run: `routeset apply --env=prod --region=eu-west --policy prefer-warm`

mike (oncall-secondary): taking over in 6m. plan: monitor p99, watch eviction rate, keep autoscale override for 30m, if p99 > 1.5s after 20m escalate to infra lead @dahlia.

maya (oncall-primary): handoff checklist (what I've done):
- notified ops and drafted customer message (ops-liaison to send)
- applied autoscale override
- switched eviction policy
- disabled prefetch for embeddings
- created tickets INC-5271 (cust-alpha), INC-5272 (cust-bravo)

maya (oncall-primary): outstanding items for primary:
- confirm p99 trend stays <1.5s for next 30m
- if eviction_count continues >150/min, run `cachectl force-evict --prefix=large-keys` (see runbook)
- coordinate with infra for potential node replacement if a single host keeps spiking (node candidate: cache-node-12)

mike (oncall-secondary): ack and will take actions. I'll post updates here every 10m or on any escalations.

incident-bot: NOTE: scheduled follow-up reminder to owner mike in 15m (thread=2333333333)

mike (oncall-secondary): quick update at +12m: p99 eu-west stabilized ~0.95s, eviction_rate=90/min, affected requests down to ~2%. No new customer tickets.

maya (oncall-primary): thanks — i’m off now, leaving the bridge. mike = primary. if things regress, escalate to @dahlia and @ravi (infra leads).

ops-liaison: status update sent to cust-alpha and cust-bravo; they acknowledged and asked for ETA — told them 15-30m.

mike (oncall-secondary): will keep thread updated. current last check: p99=0.92s, errors normal. closing initial mitigation phase; will keep monitoring until metrics quiet for 45m.

sre-bot: RESOLVE suggestion: consider lowering prefetch concurrency default for eu-west to avoid recurrence (ticket created: INF-9482).

mike (oncall-secondary): noted, will file follow-up and handoff final state to next shift."
